title: Inside a smart meter, and the REAL problem with them.
summary: Big Clive tears down a smart meter with a wireless modem found among fly-tipped materials. He examines its internals and checks conspiracy claims about microphones, cameras and 5G.
why: Pointed to as a clear look at what is inside a smart meter, including anti-tamper switches and the cellular module.

quote.text: One of the best explorations I've seen of this is Big Clive's tear down of a smart meter.
